findings.heading: Time series and outbreak detection / 時系列分析とアウトブレイクの検出
findings.proposition: The English points the reader to the chapter file time_series.qmd; the Japanese points the same labelled link to epidemic_models.jp.qmd, a file that does not exist in chapters/ (only time_series.jp.qmd exists).
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader who clicks the link to reach the time-series and outbreak-detection chapter gets a dead link, and cannot navigate from the data page to the chapter that uses the campylobacter data.

findings.heading: Flexdashboard / 柔軟なダッシュボード
findings.proposition: The English states that the flexdashboard files are R Markdown/HTML source files, not example datasets, so they are NOT part of the appliedepidata package and must be downloaded directly from Github; the Japanese sentence says only that links to the related files follow.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader may look for the dashboard files in appliedepidata with get_data()/save_data(), fail to find them, and not understand that Github download is the only route.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / 接触者の追跡
findings.proposition: The English states that the Go.Data contact-tracing data is not part of appliedepidata; the Japanese omits that statement and only says the data can be downloaded from the links.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader may search appliedepidata (get_data(), search_data(), list_data()) for the contact-tracing datasets, find nothing, and not know that the package deliberately excludes them.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / オフライン版のダウンロード
findings.proposition: The Japanese bullet list carries a fourth bullet instructing the reader to install the R package appliedepidata, which contains all example data, with installation instructions below; the English list has only three bullets and makes no such point here.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader treats package installation as part of the offline-handbook preparation checklist, an instruction the English version does not give at this point.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / オフライン版のダウンロード
findings.proposition: The Japanese closes the offline-handbook section with a sentence saying that the package is now loaded so the data can be used in the currently open R session; the English section ends after the Mac/mobile download instructions and makes no such statement.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader expects a package-loading step or code to follow in this section and finds none, since no library() call or loading code exists anywhere on the page.
